Decision card · ord-001
Outcome: No PA · safe to act
Why: The order is for epoetin alfa J0885 for CKD (non-dialysis) and the Medicare MAC coverage article (A58982) lists J0885 as covered for CKD not on dialysis when documentation requirements and clinical thresholds are met.
Why: Patient has diagnosis D63.1 and N18.32 (CKD not on dialysis), hemoglobin 9.4 g/dL (<10), and eGFR 38 mL/min/1.73m2 (<45) — these meet the coverage thresholds cited for CKD non-dialysis ESA use.
Next step: Proceed with administration/billing under Original Medicare; include required documentation with the claim (serum creatinine and/or GFR, diagnosis codes D63.1 and N18.32, pre-treatment iron studies/TSAT and ferritin per policy, and any dosing details). Retain records in case Medicare requests supporting documentation.
Source: Billing and Coding Article A58982 (for LCD L39237), pages 9–10 — required documentation elements and coverage criteria for CKD not on dialysis (J0885 listed; Hb <10 threshold; GFR guidance and required serum creatinine/GFR and iron studies).

Decision card · ord-001
Outcome: No PA · not safe to act
Why: Medicare Part B coverage for ESAs (J0885) is governed by LCD L39237 / Billing & Coding Article A58982 which do not impose a Medicare prior authorization requirement for J0885 (they set coverage/medical necessity criteria instead) (A58982 pp. 9–11).
Why: Coverage criteria require specific documentation be present prior to/during ESA therapy — e.g., diagnosis D63.1 with an appropriate CKD code (N18.32 is an allowed CKD code), pre-initiation hemoglobin <10 g/dL (patient Hgb 9.4 g/dL) and serum creatinine/GFR documentation (GFR 38 is provided) (A58982 pp. 9–11).
Why: The policy also requires evaluation of iron stores (TSAT ≥20% and ferritin ≥100 ng/mL) prior to initiating ESA therapy; those iron lab values are not present in the record, so medical necessity documentation is incomplete (A58982 pp. 10–11).
Next step: Staff should obtain and document recent iron studies (transferrin saturation and ferritin) and ensure all required documentation (most recent Hb, serum creatinine/GFR, and the listed diagnosis codes with appropriate ESA modifiers) are in the chart before administering/billing.
Source: Billing and Coding Article A58982, Erythropoiesis Stimulating Agents (for L39237), Revision effective 2026-10-01 — Required Documentation and Coverage Criteria (pages 9–11).

Decision card · ord-002
Outcome: Other gate (coverage criteria not met) · not safe to act
Why: Hb 9.4 g/dL meets the LCD threshold (<10 g/dL) for ESA initiation.
Why: Patient eGFR 52 mL/min/1.73 m2 exceeds the LCD requirement of GFR < 45 mL/min/1.73 m2 for CKD patients not on dialysis, so coverage criteria are not satisfied.

Source: LCD L39237 Erythropoiesis Stimulating Agents (Palmetto GBA), Coverage Criteria for CKD not on dialysis — page 7; Billing & Coding Article A58982, Required documentation/GFR and modifier EC guidance — pages 10–11.

Decision card · ord-002
Outcome: Other gate (coverage criteria not met) · not safe to act
Why: Patient has D63.1 (anemia of CKD) but the billing/coding article for L39237 requires a CKD stage code of N18.32, N18.4, or N18.5 for non-dialysis CKD ESA use; the submitted stage code is N18.31 (CKD stage 3a), which is not listed as an accepted stage for coverage.
Why: The LCD discusses GFR/stage groupings and shows anemia prevalence by GFR, but the billing article enforces specific stage codes to support medical necessity for J0885 (non‑ESRD ESA).
Next step: Staff should either (a) provide documentation showing the patient’s CKD stage meets one of the covered stages (e.g., billing N18.32, N18.4, or N18.5 with supporting labs), (b) correct the diagnosis coding if an incorrect stage code was submitted, or (c) if CKD stage truly is 3a, consider alternative management (or pursue an appeal/coverage exception) because current documentation does not meet the LCD billing article coverage requirements.
Source: Billing and Coding Article A58982 (Erythropoiesis Stimulating Agents for L39237), page 10 (requirement that for CKD non-dialysis a diagnosis of D63.1 and a stage code such as N18.32, N18.4, or N18.5 must be billed) and page 21 (Group 2 — patients with CKD not on dialysis — require dual diagnoses); LCD L39237, page 15 (discussion of GFR/stage categories).

Decision card · ord-002
Outcome: Other gate (coverage criteria not met) · not safe to act
Why: LCD/article require CKD non-dialysis patients to meet GFR/CKD stage criteria for ESA coverage; guidance notes GFR <45 mL/min/1.73m2 (and stage beyond IIIa) is the reasonable threshold, and stage I–IIIa (including N18.31) do not meet coverage criteria.
Why: Patient facts show eGFR 52 (CKD stage 3a, N18.31) with Hgb 9.4 g/dL — Hgb criterion met but the eGFR/CKD stage criterion is not met per the coverage article.
Next step: Staff should not authorize; obtain/update renal function documentation or a supporting diagnosis showing CKD stage that meets coverage (eg, GFR <45 or an applicable N18.32/N18.4/N18.5), or consider alternative management. If new labs/diagnosis are provided, re-check coverage against L39237 and A58982.
Source: LCD L39237 (Palmetto GBA) — coverage statement and scope (page 3); Billing & Coding Article A58982, Erythropoiesis Stimulating Agents (for L39237) — required documentation and GFR/diagnosis requirements, dosing and exclusions (pages 10–11, 13).

Outcome: PA required · not safe to act

Next step: Submit a prior authorization request including clinical documentation showing either (a) trials of at least two preferred IV iron therapies (e.g., ferumoxytol, sodium ferric gluconate, iron sucrose) of ≥3 weeks each with minimal response, or (b) documented contraindication/intolerance to at least two preferred IV iron therapies; include relevant labs (Hgb 9.4 g/dL, eGFR 38) and clinical notes. Follow standard UHC MA PA submission process for injectable medications.
Source: UnitedHealthcare Medicare Advantage Drug Policy IAP.001.30 (Medicare Part B Step Therapy Programs), pages 8 and 18 (Intravenous Iron Replacement Therapy — non-preferred: J1439; step therapy criteria); patient record (journey_get for maria-uhc, order ord-004, date_of_service 2026-11-15).
